sourceInformation.source: River Raid (1982), designed by Carol Shaw, published by Activision
sourceInformation.tech: Three.js r180 (0.180.0), WebGPURenderer with WebGPU and WebGL 2 fallback; Rapier 3D 0.19.3; Web Audio; Gamepad API; AI Hub Session Protocol v1 / client 1.4.0; esbuild 0.25.12
sourceInformation.artDirection: Procedural cel-shaded low-poly models, navy ink edges, jade water, golden aircraft and paper-colored arcade UI
sourceInformation.animation: Three.js AnimationMixer, AnimationClip and keyframe tracks for aircraft idle, exhaust, rotors, pickups, turrets and explosions; Rapier debris
sourceInformation.audio: Code-generated adaptive synth groove (music defaults to 10%), engine, weapons, impacts, refueling bells and formant-filtered gibberish radio voices; no audio files
sourceInformation.online: AI Hub host-authoritative shared-world co-op for 1–4; standalone same-device co-op for 1–2; no public matchmaking
sourceInformation.testing: Headless state and Rapier collision tests; full scripted campaign with invulnerability; Chromium WebGPU draw/state checks and WebGL 2 visual review; emulated standard gamepads and phone touch; generated-audio analysis; official AI Hub harness (2 and 4 players, 150 ms latency, 50 ms jitter, 5% loss, host-leave and dedicated-server cases). Physical controllers, real mobile hardware and human listening: unknown.
sourceInformation.research: Original Activision Atari 2600 River Raid manual via AtariAge: controls, fuel, scoring, bridges, enemies and sound cues; Atari release information and visual references; official Three.js/Rapier documentation; AI Hub Session Protocol v1 and its official harness.
sourceInformation.environment: Codex CLI (headless); Linux / Ubuntu 26.04 on WSL2

testingFeedback: 10 product issues found and fixed during automated tests, state inspection and visual review: duplicate Enter activation, menu repeat, touch pulse hit testing, terrain winding, boss framing, bridge bypass, checkpoint progress, attract tuning restoration, radio overlap and fuel-dock overlap. Test-runner timing and browser launch configuration are excluded.
1 objective-breaking issue: an intact bridge could be bypassed. Progress now stops at uncleared spans and victory requires all three bridges.

The full scripted campaign with real Rapier queries and weapon hits: it verified fuel stops, all three bridges, both boss turrets, the core and the ending. The official Hub harness also verified all network lifecycle cases.
Early WebGPU screenshots were least useful: software-adapter captures could be blank even when state and draw counters were valid. WebGL 2 screenshots were used for visual review.
engineFeedback: Three.js combines procedural cel-shaded geometry with AnimationMixer and keyframe tracks cleanly, and the same scene runs through WebGPU and WebGL 2.

Yes. MeshToonMaterial in r180 does not accept flatShading. The software WebGPU browser also needed the Vulkan and ANGLE SwiftShader flags together. Removed the unsupported property and checked both backends.
The authoritative arcade flight simulation, river course, controller focus and input system, procedural audio, and shared-world Hub adapter.
Coordinating renderer initialization and device recovery with physics, local input and the Hub start/end clock across multiple copies.
none; upstream Three.js and Rapier were not modified.
Reliable headless WebGPU frame capture across software adapters.
promptFeedback: The source research requirement and concrete controller, attract-mode and developer-tool requirements gave the vertical slice a clear purpose.
Standalone multiplayer did not specify a connection method. Implemented same-device co-op for 1–2, plus online AI Hub co-op for 1–4.
Making procedural art, synthesis, input assistance, complete campaign pacing and authoritative multiplayer work together in one portable HTML.
Specify a target campaign duration and whether standalone remote matchmaking or direct peer connections are required.

aiHub.name: River Renegade
aiHub.description: Skim a winding river in a golden jet, raid three bridges, and steal fuel before your tank runs dry. Fly solo or bring wingmates to break the Iron Heron's blockade.
aiHub.controls: Stick / WASD: steer and throttle; Cross / RT / Space: fire; Square / Shift: pulse; Options / Esc: pause. P2: arrows, Enter, Right Shift. Touch: drag to fly, auto-fire, tap pulse.
